cards.title: Embrace 'Slow September' for Better Family Life
cards.body: September pressure to optimize can lead to burnout for families. Instead, slow down and enjoy simple moments like chatting with strangers and letting kids experience boredom. This approach reaps real benefits for family wellbeing.

cards.title: I Didn't Know I Was Pregnant Until Birth
cards.body: A woman describes experiencing no typical pregnancy symptoms like morning sickness or fatigue before giving birth at age 19. Her mother initially didn't believe she'd actually had a baby, even after seeing the newborn on FaceTime. This rare experience sheds light on cryptic pregnancies.

cards.title: Maternity Care in Ireland Needs Universal Access
cards.body: A two-tier maternity system is finally giving way to universal state care in Ireland. Private interests and highly paid doctors are resisting this change. Expecting mothers shouldn't have to pay to feel safe during childbirth.

cards.title: Teaching Children to Use AI Safely at Home
cards.body: Artificial intelligence can seem overwhelming for parents navigating new technology with kids. Six practical family rules can help parents guide children safely through AI. These guidelines address real concerns about child safety online.

cards.title: House Mapping Helps ADHD Families Reduce Clutter
cards.body: House mapping is a practical strategy for ADHD households to organize spaces around how families naturally live. This approach reduces both physical clutter and mental fatigue. It's especially helpful for busy or overwhelmed families.

cards.title: When Parents Play Financial Favorites With Children
cards.body: Financial favoritism—when parents help one child more than another—can cause lasting jealousy and resentment. These feelings often persist well into adulthood. Experts offer guidance on avoiding this damaging dynamic.
